dialog.agent:
Before I make the flyer I need one thing from you: **what's the event date?** You said it has to be on the flyer, and I don't want to guess it. Please give it exactly as you want it printed, for example "Saturday 14 June".

Once I have it, the flyer will show only these lines:
- Pottery Workshop
- Clay House Studio
- 14:00–16:00
- [your date]
- Beginners welcome

It will use soft earthy colours and a simple drawing of a clay bowl, with no other wording.

Your account's image generator only makes square, landscape or tall (9:16) images, not 4:5. To get 4:5, I'll make the flyer first and then reshape it to 4:5 with the image editor.
dialog.why: It asks the user for the event date to put on the flyer and waits for that answer before making anything.
dialog.user: The date is 24 July 2027. Making it first and then reshaping to 4:5 is fine, go ahead.

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the flyer because your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits. Nothing was created and no credits were spent.

I tried the cheapest image setting your free plan offers (about 5 credits per image), so there isn't a cheaper option to fall back on. Reshaping to 4:5 afterwards would cost another 5 credits or so, so plan for about 10 credits in total.

Once you've added credits or bought a credit pack, tell me and I'll make it straight away with what we agreed:
- **Text, and nothing else:** Pottery Workshop · Clay House Studio · 24 July 2027 · 14:00–16:00 · Beginners welcome
- **Look:** soft earthy colours (terracotta, sand, clay brown, soft sage) and a simple drawing of a clay bowl
- **Shape:** made tall first, then reshaped to 4:5

style.prompt:
A clean, minimal portrait event flyer in soft earthy colours (warm terracotta, sand beige, muted clay brown, soft sage). In the centre, a simple hand-drawn line illustration of a clay bowl. Plenty of empty space so the design can be cropped to a 4:5 portrait format without losing anything. The flyer shows exactly these lines of text and no other words, letters or logos, spelled exactly:
"Pottery Workshop" (large title at the top)
"Clay House Studio"
"24 July 2027"
"14:00–16:00"
"Beginners welcome"
Clear, legible serif typography, all text kept well inside the central area of the image.
